_comment: EXAMPLE DATA: replace everything with your own resume. This file is the single source of truth for every tailored resume: tailoring may reorder, select and bold these facts, but never adds new ones. Each project needs a unique 'key' (used by the job scorer) and an optional one-line 'pitch' (used in referral messages). Only 'projects' is printed; 'extra_projects' can be swapped in for roles where they fit better.
name: Your Name

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

projects.name: TaskFlow – Team Task Management API
projects.pitch: TaskFlow, a FastAPI + PostgreSQL task-management API with JWT auth and CI
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, pytest, GitHub Actions
bullets: Built a REST API with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for teams to create, assign and track tasks, with JWT authentication and role-based access.
Added Redis caching for the most-read endpoints and pagination for large task lists.
Wrote pytest unit and integration tests and a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs them on every pull request.
Packaged the service with Docker for one-command local setup and deployment.

projects.name: Chatter – Real-Time Chat Application
projects.pitch: Chatter, a real-time chat app built with React, Node.js and WebSockets
projects.stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Socket.IO, MongoDB, Jest
bullets: Built a real-time chat app with rooms, typing indicators and read receipts using React.js, Express.js and Socket.IO.
Stored users and message history in MongoDB with indexes for fast room loading.
Tested the API and socket events with Jest.

projects.name: PricePing – Price-Drop Alert Bot
projects.pitch: PricePing, a Python bot that tracks product prices and sends alerts
bullets: Built a Python scraper that checks product prices on a schedule and emails users when a price drops below their target.
Added a small Flask dashboard to manage tracked products, backed by SQLite.

extra_projects.name: Spam Detector – Email Classification Model
extra_projects.pitch: a spam-classification model trained with scikit-learn and served through a FastAPI endpoint
bullets: Trained a scikit-learn text classifier on a public email dataset and reported precision, recall and a confusion matrix.
Served the model through a FastAPI endpoint for single and batch predictions.

achievements: Solved 300+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems on LeetCode and other platforms.

leadership.title: Coding Club – Core Member
bullets: Organised workshops and coding contests for students, handling logistics and outreach.
